verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own RAG feature pulls relevant content from your documents into chat responses, @-mentioned files are fed to the AI as context, and scheduled automations can summarize new files, so users get AI output grounded in their data. The evidence frames this as question-answering over retrieved context rather than a dedicated insights or suggestions feature. Two community users report RAG failing in no-GPU, external-API-only setups, which limits confidence. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic insight and suggestion generation over user data, a dedicated data-analysis or insights feature (e.g., over CSVs or datasets), and independent corroboration that RAG works reliably across deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: RAG can retrieve and incorporate the relevant information from that source into the chat response.
retrieving relevant information from a wide range of sources such as local and remote documents, web content, and even multimedia sources like YouTube videos.
@ mentions a file; its content is fed to the AI as context.
